    "title": "Retry count update loses attempts under concurrent cron runs",

If two cron invocations process the same reminder simultaneously, both can read the same retryCount and both write the same incremented value, so two failed attempts count as one. This undermines the delete-after-two-failures logic and can allow extra scheduling attempts. Use an atomic Prisma `increment: 1` or an `updateMany` guarded by the expected retryCount."

A persistent error before `twilio.scheduleSMS` is ever called, such as invalid booking metadata or a failing `bookingMetadataSchema.parse`, therefore counts as an SMS scheduling failure, and after two runs the reminder is deleted even though no SMS was attempted. findings.title: DeleteMany retryCount branch is not scoped to SMS
findings.body: This handler is the SMS workflow scheduler, and the first OR branch filters `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS`, but the second OR branch only requires `retryCount > 1`. Because `WorkflowReminder` is shared by EMAIL/SMS/WHATSAPP methods, any non-SMS reminder whose `retryCount` becomes > 1 (now or in future code paths) will be deleted by this SMS cron. Add `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` to the retryCount branch or otherwise constrain the delete to SMS reminders.

findings.title: Retry count update loses attempts under concurrent cron runs
findings.body: The update writes `retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1` using the value loaded by `findMany` earlier in the handler. If two cron invocations process the same reminder simultaneously, both can read the same retryCount and both write the same incremented value, so two failed attempts count as one. This undermines the delete-after-two-failures logic and can allow extra scheduling attempts. Use an atomic Prisma `increment: 1` or an `updateMany` guarded by the expected retryCount.

findings.title: Catch increments retryCount for errors unrelated to SMS scheduling
findings.body: The `try` block wraps message/template building, DB lookups, metadata parsing, and the Twilio call. The `catch` at line 189 increments `retryCount` for any of those failures. A persistent error before `twilio.scheduleSMS` is ever called, such as invalid booking metadata or a failing `bookingMetadataSchema.parse`, therefore counts as an SMS scheduling failure, and after two runs the reminder is deleted even though no SMS was attempted. Scope retry counting to the actual `scheduleSMS` call or handle pre-scheduling errors separately.

findings.title: No tests for retry limit and deletion behavior
findings.body: This PR adds a retry counter, increments it in the false-result and catch paths, and changes `deleteMany` to prune reminders with `retryCount > 1`, but no tests are added. The behavior needs coverage for one failure, two failures, successful scheduling after a failure, and non-SMS reminders so the retry/delete semantics do not regress.
